clues: This city sits on a high flat plain in a river valley in the Andes. It is one of the main cities of the west of Venezuela.
Rain falls hard here from April to November, yet this city still gets lots of sun. Its valley is too narrow for fog to build up and linger.
This city was founded in 1558 by Captain Juan Rodríguez Suárez. Back then, its land formed part of New Granada.
Ride fans come here for the highest and longest cable car in the whole world. No cable car on Earth is higher or longer than this one.
From the streets of this city, you can see Pico Bolívar, the tallest peak in the whole country. It towers high above the river valley.
